decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen is the firm's publicly announced flagship and has won the Deutsches Brotinstitut gold medal again, so its visible commitment and its proven quality make keeping it the clear choice.

The dark barley malt rye bread uses the firm's existing rye know-how and facilities at little extra cost, and having already kept it once, management can still attribute soft demand to temporary causes rather than admit a mistake.
The marzipan stollen rounds out the committed Christmas stollen and gift assortment around the flagship, so dropping it would weaken the seasonal direction the firm has made public.
